verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents rule-based handling of incoming mail through plain-English AI filters that label, star and archive, triggers that fire when emails arrive, and Splits that divide the inbox. For teams, it offers comments and @mentions that share a thread with a teammate. Nothing shows explicit assignment of a conversation to an owner, and one Front power-user doubted the bundling features could replace team inboxes. Missing for 10: explicit conversation assignment/ownership, rules that route mail to specific teammates or shared team inboxes, independent hands-on corroboration of team routing.
